basic_details.job_title: NHM Kerala Diabetes Educator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

age_limit.details: Age for contract basis shall not exceed 40 years as on 01.09.2026.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | diabetes educator (ncd): GNM / BSc Nursing from a recognized institution. Valid registration with Kerala Nurses & midwives Council (KNMC). At least 1 yr of work experience in the area of diabetes.

selection_process: Selection will be based on qualification
experience and performance in the interview. The Society may also require candidates to undertake a demonstration of skills in the area or specialization concerned
based on recommendations of a selection committee.

Visit the official website at www.arogyakeralam.gov.in to submit the application online by 5 pm on 16.10.2026. Ensure the application is complete in all respects. Prepare a scanned copy of copies of qualifications / experiences as a single PDF file. Forward the scanned single PDF file to the email ID [email protected]. Note that physical copies sent by post or other means to the NHM State office are not required and will not be considered.
important_instructions: Applications forwarded other than through www.arogyakeralam.gov.in will NOT BE CONSIDERED. Incomplete applications will not be considered for shortlisting. Selected candidates should be willing to relocate anywhere in the State and work in any District of Kerala as decided by the Society. Applicants should be excellent in decision making and data handling. Initial appointment is for a period of three months, and further extension will be based on performance and support from UNICEF. No TA/DA will be paid for the interview. All communications, including the interview call letter, will be only through email. The posts are temporary during the operation of the Technical Support Group with no claim for permanency. Canvassing in any form will lead to automatic disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: National Health Mission Kerala (NHM Kerala) is conducting this recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for NHM Kerala Diabetes Educator (NCD)?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies available for the post of Diabetes Educator (NCD).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NHM Kerala Diabetes Educator (NCD)?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application online and email the scanned documents is 16 October 2026 by 5 pm.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a GNM or BSc Nursing from a recognized institution with valid registration with the Kerala Nurses & midwives Council (KNMC) and at least 1 year of work experience in the area of diabetes.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age for the contract basis shall not exceed 40 years as on 01.09.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for NHM Kerala Diabetes Educator (NCD)?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs. 35,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates submit their application?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their application online through www.arogyakeralam.gov.in and forward the scanned copy of qualifications and experiences as a single PDF file to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this post?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: Successful candidates will be appointed on contract initially for a period of three months, with further extension based on performance and support from UNICEF.

faq.question: Q10. Where should candidates check for interview call letters and updates?
faq.answer: All communications, including interview call letters, will be sent through email, and candidates should browse www.arogyakeralam.gov.in regularly for updates.
